purpose: Remove Function/sloppy and function-renaming confounds before attributing archived JS fusion losses.

module_generation.unchanged_clones: Copy complete archived module bytes unchanged; verify identical SHA. Import from own fresh diagnosis subdirectories. Keep __fn0 name, ESM strictness, helper/destination bodies, original metadata and exports.
module_generation.no_padding: Apply exactly one concat allocation/two-copy-loop replacement only inside primary __fn0 of complete prior module. Bind concat result to mapped prefix; every other byte including all helpers/destination emitter/exports stays unchanged.
module_generation.no_pluszero: Remove exactly four literal +0 occurrences only inside primary __fn0 of complete checked module; keep every other byte unchanged.
module_generation.path_confound: No-op clone vs original remains explicit baseline for module-URL/compilation and import-order differences. Path cannot be identical for independently loaded modules.

common_boundary.input_capture: Copy both xs and ys with Uint32Array.slice per call. Same wrapper construction and run signature across all variants.
common_boundary.output: Fresh owned Array; full length + weighted all-word moduloU32 checksum inside timer; exact outputs/nonmutation/repeated and changed-input lifetime outside timer.
common_boundary.consumer: Same common batch loop and checksum routine across variants.
common_boundary.inlining: Preserve scalar helper bodies already emitted inline. Do not add/remove consumer or wrapper inlining hints.

uninstrumented_reproduction.calibration: Same frozen 1,double... stop8ms or65536 cap; exact checksum/iteration journal.
uninstrumented_reproduction.order: Fixed frame order; independently seeded Fisher-Yates variant order each round.
uninstrumented_reproduction.separation: Run only after parent grants exclusive supplemental window. Existing Node/browser measurements preserved.
uninstrumented_reproduction.statistics: Retain every pair per frame/process. Conditional4000 seeded within-process bootstrap; three independent process ratios separate. No pooled27round confidence.

instrumented_evidence.profile_frame: left composed high65536, fixed before new measurements
instrumented_evidence.scope: Separate fresh single-variant processes with64warmups+256calls. Parse actual final optimization tiers/function source URL/inlining decisions/ARM64 generated code. Instrumented timings excluded. No huge TurboFan IR dump.
instrumented_evidence.allocation_validation: Untimed instrumented copies count only primary new Array constructions; common capture performs2 typed-array copies separately. Constructor counting changes code and is NOT used for performance attribution. Static primary allocation sites shown below; dynamic counted module must compare full outputs before using count. Heap sample profiles are sampling, not exact object counts.
instrumented_evidence.limits: Final code/inlining evidence can rule out specific hypotheses; source-level controlled effect need not isolate a single machine instruction. If no-op baseline is unstable, or no-padding does not isolate source-shape slowdown, retain exact JIT cause unknown.
